title: Tierwise provenance sidecar
description: Structure of a provenance sidecar (section 10.6, [BUNDLE-139] to [BUNDLE-150]). A sidecar holds exactly one provenance record, and it is kept beside a bundle and never changes the bundle bytes or the digest ([BUNDLE-140], [DET-3]). The schema checks shape and the forms of [BUNDLE-150]. It does not check that bundleVersion matches the bundle that the sidecar is checked against ([BUNDLE-144], [BUNDLE-151]), that the createdAt date is a real calendar date, the file name of the sidecar ([BUNDLE-149]), or the content of publisher, which is an opaque label ([BUNDLE-150]). The checker reports those. An evaluator never reads a sidecar ([BUNDLE-145]).

bundleVersion.description: The bundleVersion of the bundle that this record describes: the string sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits ([BUNDLE-141], [BUNDLE-5]).

createdAt.description: The time at which the record was created: an RFC 3339 time in UTC, with an uppercase T separator, a Z offset, seconds and no fractional seconds ([BUNDLE-141], [BUNDLE-150] (b)). The pattern checks the form and the field ranges, not the length of each month.

gitCommit.description: OPTIONAL. The full commit identifier of the source, 40 or 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits ([BUNDLE-142], [BUNDLE-150] (a)). Absent when the source has no commit.

publisher.description: OPTIONAL. An opaque label that names the publisher. No evaluator reads it, and the sidecar does not authenticate it ([BUNDLE-142], [BUNDLE-150] (c)).
